description: This script performs backend API testing for the Discourse Engine, including health checks, session creation, message analysis, and message retrieval.

methods.name: test_api_health
methods.description: Checks if the backend API is running by sending a GET request to the root URL.

methods.name: test_create_session
methods.description: Creates a new session with sample avatar data via POST request.

methods.name: test_get_session
methods.description: Retrieves session data by session ID and verifies required fields.

methods.name: test_analyze_message
methods.description: Sends a toxic message for pattern detection and verifies response.

methods.name: test_get_messages
methods.description: Retrieves all messages for a session and checks message structure.

methods.name: test_analyze_healthy_message
methods.description: Sends a healthy message for pattern detection and verifies response.

methods.name: run_all_tests
methods.description: Runs all individual API tests sequentially and summarizes results.
